note: Small BLM campground on a juniper-and-sage bench above the North Platte River near Bennett Peak, reached by about 18 miles of gravel (County Road 660, then BLM Road 3404) from WY-230 east of Riverside. Spurs are back-in, though a fifth-wheel toy hauler has fit on a large dirt pad. A foot trail leads down to wade-fishing; rainbow and brown trout, bighorn sheep and bald eagles. --Claude
summary: BLM page read: 6 sites, no pull-throughs, vault toilet, day-use parking, no fee (confirmed). rec.gov POI 14704 information-only -> booking FCFS written.
